_meta.provenance_policy: Every value carries provenance: 'sourced' (citation attached) or 'verify' (structural placeholder — must be confirmed against the current bureau/state tables before production use). The engine refuses to silently apply 'verify' values: it applies them and emits a VERIFY finding so no unconfirmed number hides in a worksheet.
